issue: Every core dependency (networkx, numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, tqdm, datasets, huggingface-hub, sentence-transformers, matplotlib) is declared TWICE
description: requirements.txt duplicates pyproject.toml's [project.dependencies] verbatim (same version floors). pytest/pytest-cov/ruff are also duplicated, but requirements.txt declares them UNCONDITIONALLY where pyproject.toml correctly scopes them to the [dev] extra.
recommended_fix: requirements.txt should either be regenerated as a pinned lock file derived FROM pyproject.toml (e.g. via pip-compile), or reduced to a one-line pointer ('pip install -e .[dev]'); keeping two hand-maintained sources of the same floors risks silent drift (not yet found to have drifted, but there is no mechanism preventing it)

issue: sentence-transformers version floor CONFLICTED within pyproject.toml itself
description: pyproject.toml's core [project.dependencies] requires >=5.3.0, but its own [dense] optional-dependencies extra (meant to be an alternative way to get dense-embedding support) independently declared >=2.2.0 -- a stale floor that predated sentence-transformers becoming a core dependency and was never actually reachable as a looser install once the core deps were resolved. requirements.txt already correctly used >=5.3.0 (no conflict there).
recommended_fix: Aligned pyproject.toml's [dense] extra to >=5.3.0 to match the core requirement, with an explanatory comment.

issue: Python version: pyproject.toml declares >=3.11; CI pins exactly 3.12; .venv runs 3.12.3; ambient/ephemeral shells in this session ran a DIFFERENT environment (a 'modal-venv' with older, non-identical package versions and NO PySCIPOpt/gurobipy installed) that is not referenced anywhere in repository documentation
description: Discovered directly this stage: invoking bare 'python3'/'pytest' in an interactive shell resolved to an unrelated ambient virtualenv, producing 23 spuriously-skipped tests across every full-suite run earlier in this session, none of which were failures once re-run against the repo's own .venv (1272 passed, 0 skipped)
recommended_fix: This is the single highest-value finding of this stage: all commands (Makefile targets, the new offline-reproduction script, this stage's own validation) now explicitly invoke $(VENV)/bin/python or .venv/bin/python rather than a bare 'python'/'python3', so this ambiguity cannot recur silently
